2026 Google DeepMind tie: the Gemini 4 Argon model card and the Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report (218 pages, linked from the card) both print 'October 2026' and were published together; the rule does not separate them, and the model card (the document in the developer's model-card index) was taken as the row.
